text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I was looking for you. Um, do you 
remember what we talked about before?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yup, yup☆ Finding the "mature charm" 
inside Karen... Today, I'd like you to 
accompany me for that!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Well then, right away... let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pulled along by the hand in a whirlwind, 
the place she brought me to had—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Right, mind your fingertips all the way to 
the end. Also, stay aware of your ears and 
tail. No wasted movements.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Karen-san, you look amazing~! So 
graceful, I can't take my eyes off ya!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, thanks☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
How to show off "mature charm"! I knew 
asking City-san was the right choice♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City-san really is somethin' else. Haa~ I 
wonder if I practiced under a pro's 
guidance, if I could ever look like that 
too...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Curious? Wanna give it a shot?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Eh?! N-N-No way! I'll pass, I shouldn't 
get in your way!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Umm... m-maybe next time.........

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Then that's a promise☆ Next time, 
all three of us will strike a pose and 
take photos together, okay? ☆

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
All right, moving on! Next, something like 
this... Trainer-san, photo please♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: How about something like this next?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh?! You look just like the President! 
So sophisticated~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And then~ like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wah, wah, this time you look just like 
Brian-san! So stoic and cool!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. As expected, Karen, you really 
know how to work the camera.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay~♪ Let's check them right away and post 
to Umastagram—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I guess this is also for future 
growth?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"#MatureKaren #CoolStyle 
#DidYourHeartSkipABeat?" —And posted.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa~! Karen-san, you're amazing! Over 
10,000 Umalikes in an instant... Wah, wah, 
so many comments too~!

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Different from usual, makes my heart 
race!" "Cute Curren Chan is great, but a 
mature look is totally different and 
amazing too!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the comments left on the photo, 
every single reaction was overwhelmingly 
positive. —And yet.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I think the photos are really 
good. But what is it? Something feels...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmm, you feel it too, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I thought every single one was 
mature, just like a "city girl"... and 
looked totally great, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank you! ...Still, you know...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if that's really... "Karen's" 
kind of "mature charm."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Muttering her doubts softly, Curren Chan 
tilted her head with her usual adorable 
demeanor.
